plan.goal: Establish bounded, independently verifiable JPEG decoder raster evidence for WIC/GDI+ candidates, separating absolute-reference cases from differential-only comparisons, while preserving codec admission, memory and cancellation boundaries without authorizing decoder adoption.

tasks.goal: Implement and measure the W8 JPEG decoder matrix under DC-MP-IMG2 without changing product decode policy.

inputs.description: Full caller-selected W8 directive: docs/development/evidence-published/img2-w8-latest/tern-next-directive.txt (verbatim 1425 lines). All constraints and acceptance below are projections of it.
MP-IMG1/MP-SEC3 completion; MP ss19.55-.60; DC-MP-IMG2 and media admission; BUILD_AND_RUN 4.23-4.27; TESTING; ADR-0009/0012. W7 limited completion does not satisfy MP-IMG3.
Reuse wic_probe.ps1, gdiplus_probe.ps1, the W2 worker and stop contract, the W6 sampler, W7 canonical PNG row decoding and verifier patterns. No probe, product decoder, dependency or Runtime change.

constraints.text: Use DC-MP-IMG2 under ADR-0009/0012 only. Start 06ee0e03ace5ffa007e3181b5996e2d207502837 on dev. Preserve W1-W7 source, native, Gate and review bytes; no push, main or release.

Twelve fixed sources: three DC-only hand-built baseline grayscale JPEGs with an independently derived absolute reference, five non-uniform real baseline JPEGs (4:4:4 and 4:2:0 at 256 and 1024), two derived malformed streams and two progressive classes recorded NOT_RUN because no approved progressive encoder exists.

Absolute expectations come from parsed quantization, Huffman and DC prediction plus the level shift only; encoder output and decoder output are never the reference. Differential agreement is never labelled absolute correctness.

W8 experimental limits: dimension 2048, 4,194,304 pixels, 8 bits per channel, 16 MiB decoded, 16 MiB scratch, 16 MiB encoded input, 32 MiB output, 256 MiB work root, 8 MiB report, 128 trace records/128 KiB, 64 KiB capture, 45 s worker, 300 s batch, one worker, 12 sources and 24 legs.

Do not change crates/media admission, probe semantics, decode_compare CLI, W1-W7 evidence, GPUI, Runtime, dependencies or unsafe/FFI. GDI+ has no pre-materialization admission or trace; record that as NOT_MEASURED rather than inventing stages.

Keep DECODED_CONTENT_VERIFIED, DECODED_DIFFERENTIAL_ONLY, UNSUPPORTED, OVERSIZE, CORRUPT_REFUSED, TAMPER_NOT_VERIFIED, TIMEOUT, CANCELLED, UNVERIFIED_RACE and NOT_RUN distinct. Malformed streams never reach content verification.

Ship a fail-closed verifier and exercise at least the 32 required mutation classes, including coherent trace mutations, through verify(); structural replay keeps source_identity_verified=false and closure_eligible=false.
Stop and record DESIGN_BLOCKED, AUTHORITY_BLOCKED, DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED, SAFETY_BLOCKED, NOT_RUN, NOT_MEASURED or NOT_VERIFIED instead of inventing an unapproved design, tolerance or decoder adoption.

outputs.description: Deterministic W6 fixtures, repeated process sampler/matrix, independent fail-closed verifier and focused tests.
Bounded Windows matrix, raw sample series, source/executable identities, cohort comparisons, arithmetic, independent raster proof and explicit measurement limitations.
Local quality and historical regression outcomes; pinned same-candidate Quality/Build receipts, artifact bytes, retention, complete Tern review and limited disposition.

acceptance.statement: New W8 SOURCE and Taskern packet are fixed before Native execution.
The twelve JPEG fixtures regenerate deterministically and their encoded markers parse independently.
An absolute pixel reference derived only from parsed JPEG tables matches both real decoders on every pixel.
WIC and GDI+ decode the non-uniform baseline sources and their pixel differences are measured quantitatively.
Differential agreement is never reported as absolute correctness.
Sampling, precision, dimensions and decoder identity are recorded from the encoded stream and the actual decoder.
Full-frame admission, output publication and the stop contract are preserved.
Malformed streams never reach content verification.
All 32 negative mutation classes are rejected by the real verifier.
W1-W7 historical regressions and current-source compatibility checks pass.
New independent Quality Core, W8 Quality and Build Gates succeed on the same candidate with matching artifacts.
A complete Tern review returns 0/0/0 while progressive classes and every unmeasured boundary stay recorded.

evaluation.requirement: Actual bounded Windows WIC and GDI+ execution plus independent marker, reference, normalized-pixel and mutation verification that preserves every missing or failing fact.
Actual Taskern prepare, unchanged local/feature/R0/historical checks, new same-candidate Gates with raw receipts, privacy-reviewed Tern packages and complete 0/0/0.
